data.title: 砂狼白子 · 环海公路休止符
data.action: 将公路自行车靠在堤坝栏杆旁，单手拉下拉链透气，另一手递过水壶，狼耳因海风微微抖动，异色瞳眸平静而认真地注视对方

data.description: 沙漠沿海公路晨风猎猎。砂狼白子身穿阿拜多斯骑行风连体防晒拉链泳衣，额头上推着防风镜。四十公里骑行结束后，她靠着公路护栏微微拉下拉链散热，狼耳在海风中警觉微动，面容沉着却认真地递来水壶，眼神透着信赖与坚毅。

data.promptProse: Shiroko Sunaookami taking a breather along a seaside highway embankment after a long bike ride. She is dressed in a sleek slate-grey and cyan aerodynamic rashguard one-piece with its front zipper lowered slightly to cool down. With cycling goggles perched on her hair and wolf ears twitching in the coastal draft, she calmly offers a hydration flask with focused heterochromatic eyes.
